title: The Price of Permission: Classification Uncertainty in Constrained Capital Markets
abstract: arXiv:2608.12634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Shariah-compliant equity screening provides a transparent setting in which institutional rules determine who may own a stock. A binary label identifies current eligibility but not whether the feasible investor base is fragmented across standards or close to changing. We define this instability as classification uncertainty and formalize its investor-base consequence through permitted investor mass. In a 1999-2024 CRSP-Compustat panel of 13,188 securities classified under seven researcher-emulated Shariah rulebooks, screening-rule disagreement and proximity to active boundaries rank next-month screen-implied transitions. U.S. Fama-MacBeth diagnostics do not support an unconditional equal-weighted permission premium, and a September 2023 DJIM/S&P methodology change produces no robust matched repricing. translated_title: 许可的代价：受限资本市场中的分类不确定性
translated_abstract: 符合伊斯兰教法的股票筛选提供了一个透明的环境，其中机构规则决定了谁可以持有某只股票。二元标签标识了当前的合格性，但并未说明可行的投资者基础是否因标准不同而分散或接近变化。我们将这种不稳定性定义为分类不确定性，并通过允许的投资者规模来形式化其对投资者基础的影响。在1999年至2024年的CRSP-Compustat面板数据中，涵盖了根据七种研究者模拟的伊斯兰教法规则手册分类的13,188只证券，筛选规则的分歧和接近活跃边界的程度预测了下一个月的筛选隐含转变。美国Fama-MacBeth诊断不支持无条件等权许可溢价，且2023年9月DJIM/S&P方法论变更未产生稳健的匹配重新定价。核心事件证据使用了马来西亚证券委员会的25份官方名单。在前一次审查前已交易的410只纳入股票中，没有发现显著的价格反应。
tldr: 本研究通过伊斯兰教法筛选规则，定义了分类不确定性并证明其能预测股票筛选状态的转变，但未发现显著的许可溢价或重新定价效应。
en_tdlr: This study defines classification uncertainty via Shariah screening rules and shows it predicts stock screening transitions, yet finds no significant permission premium or repricing effect.
